n_members_note: SF-0004 was held_for_adjudication (BL-002 hit pending Fable ruling) and is excluded from this cohort. Original builder ran it on 9 members; fix-pass reverts to 8 admitted members. DSR trial_ledger uses ledger_n_at_run=12 (total registered including superseded constructions); cohort BH uses m=8 (admitted, non-held family) — different denominators are intentional and documented.
bh_significant_by_q_note: bh_significant_by_q lists specs whose BH-adjusted q-value <= fdr_alpha=0.10. This is informational only; harness verdict governs promotion docket admission (see lane_status.json). A spec in this list with verdict='null' is NOT a pass_candidate.
formula_note: p_i = 2 * t.sf(|t_HAC_i|, df=n_subsample-1); q_i = min(m * p_i / rank_i, 1.0) with monotone enforcement; bh_significant iff q_i <= fdr_alpha. m=8 (admitted members, excluding SF-0004 held_for_adjudication). DSR uses ledger_n_at_run=12 (all registered trials including superseded constructions) — different from cohort m=8 by design.
